changes.en: The window stays responsive while many changed files are being recorded: the file list and status no longer wait for the copies to be made
changes.zh: 大量文件同时变化时窗口保持流畅：文件列表和状态不再等待版本复制完成

changes.en: Recording a burst of changed files and the first look at a newly watched folder are about twice as fast
changes.zh: 一次记录大量变化的文件，以及首次读取新监控的文件夹，速度约提高一倍

changes.en: The protection overview opens at once also with tens of thousands of watched files
changes.zh: 即使监控数万个文件，保护概览也能立即打开

changes.en: Fixed: a history backup, export or merge could hang while many files were changing
changes.zh: 修复：大量文件正在变化时，历史备份、导出或合并可能卡住

changes.en: Fixed: moving a folder to another drive failed when its path contained & or ^
changes.zh: 修复：路径中含有 & 或 ^ 时，把文件夹移到其他磁盘会失败

changes.en: "Still in the Recycle Bin" and "Only DeskTrace has it" are right also with more than 5,000 deleted files, and non-English names are matched correctly
changes.zh: “仍在回收站中”和“仅桌迹保存”在删除文件超过 5,000 个时也正确，非英文文件名也能正确匹配

changes.en: Per-folder history limits take effect as soon as they are saved
changes.zh: 按文件夹设置的历史期限保存后立即生效

changes.en: Text size uses the window's own zoom, so menus open in the right place; the compact width remembers the wide size across restarts
changes.zh: 文字大小改用窗口自身的缩放，菜单位置不再偏移；紧凑宽度在重启后仍记得原来的宽度

changes.en: Lists such as "this week" keep adding new changes; the hover preview no longer covers the row at compact width
changes.zh: “本周”等列表会持续加入新变化；紧凑宽度下悬停预览不再遮住该行
